title: Version 17.13.3
body_markdown:
*Released March 11th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed an issue that could cause some build-related tools to fail with a NotImplementedException in SimpleProjectRootElementCache. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Upgrade-to-2022-preview-1714-breaks-sln/10846785) |
| Intellicode doesn't show code completion | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Intellicode-doesnt-show-code-completion/10853148) |
| Blazor projects breaks Intellisense 17.12.2 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Blazor-projects-breaks-Intellisense-171/10803274) |
| Can't dismiss error dialogs with ESC | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Cant-dismiss-error-dialogs-with-ESC-/10845215) |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE |
| --- | --- |
| Visual Studio Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-25003**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-25003) |
| .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-24070**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-24070) |
| Visual Studio Installer Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-24998**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-24998) |
